notes.title: Dreamwalker Leaves Early Access - The Journey Begins
notes.content: [h1]Dreamwalker Has Officially Launched - Now 30% Off![/h1][p]We’re incredibly excited to announce that [b]Dreamwalker is out of Early Access and fully released[/b], with a [b]launch discount of 30%[/b] for a limited time![/p][p][/p][p]This marks the culmination of over a year of hard work by a tiny team of two people - building a surreal dreamlike world while juggling full-time jobs and our first experience making a game. What started as a small idea has grown into something bigger than we imagined, thanks in no small part to all of you who joined us early and helped shape what Dreamwalker is today.[/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][h2]What’s New in Version 1.0?[/h2][list][*][p][b]Refined card-based combat[/b] -improved balance and gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded merchant system[/b] - more shops, items, and trade options[/p][/*][*][p][b]Broader card collection[/b] - new strategies and combinations[/p][/*][*][p][b]More NPCs[/b] - a more dynamic and reactive world[/p][/*][*][p][b]New dreams to uncover[/b] - deeper story and hidden rewards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam achievements[/b] - unlockable milestones and secrets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved environmental detail and atmosphere[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]8 languages supported[/b] - English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Russian[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] If you played during Early Access, we recommend starting a new save to fully experience all the new content, story improvements, and system changes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New to Dreamwalker?[/h3][p][b]Dreamwalker[/b] is a narrative exploration game with light card-based combat, set inside a surreal dream world.[/p][p]You’ll explore shifting realities, uncover lost memories, and solve puzzles in a strange and emotional journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for dreaming with us.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the game, please consider [b]leaving a review or telling a friend[/b] - it helps a small team like ours more than you know.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Dreamwalker Devs [/p]
